title: Replacement Packaging on Travelled PAP Therapy Equipment Units
content:
# Replacement Packaging on Travelled PAP Therapy Equipment Units

**Schedule.** A self-pay PAP Therapy Equipment unit that travelled to the patient carries its replacement packaging on top of the used-accessory amount the patient bears on return:

| Hand-over recorded among the unit's deliveries | Packaging (USD) |
|---|---|
| a delivery shipped for a virtual setup | 6.50 |
| no virtual-setup delivery, but a delivery set up in the patient's home | 3.25 |
| any other hand-over (branch setup, courier) | 0.00 |

**Where it is read.** The hand-over is the delivery mode of the deliveries in the device's service history. A record with any virtual-setup delivery carries 6.50; otherwise a record with any in-home-setup delivery carries 3.25; otherwise nothing.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- An Auto-Adjusting CPAP System (E0601) shipped for a virtual setup: 6.50 added.
- A Bilevel PAP Spontaneous System (E0470) set up in the home: 3.25 added.
- A Travel CPAP System (E0601) handed over by courier: nothing added.
